description:
About the engagement

You join a dedicated team delivering Advanced MSP and Cloud Center of Excellence (CCoE) services to a large enterprise customer across AWS, Azure and GCP, with AWS as the largest estate (150+ accounts). The customer's business units run containerized workloads on EKS, and this seat is the team's primary owner of that platform.

The team combines onsite CCoE architects at the customer's site, US-remote operations engineers, and an offshore 24x7 monitoring team. You work US business hours and are the escalation point for EKS and pipeline issues raised by monitoring, the business units or the CCoE.

What you'll do

EKS cluster operations and lifecycle

  • Operate the customer's EKS clusters day to day: node groups, add-ons, networking (VPC CNI, CoreDNS, ingress/load balancer controllers), storage (EBS/EFS CSI) and IAM roles for service accounts.

  • Plan and execute Kubernetes version upgrades to keep every cluster inside AWS's supported window; manage deprecated API removals with the application teams ahead of each upgrade.

  • Own capacity, autoscaling (Cluster Autoscaler or Karpenter) and right-sizing recommendations for the container platform.

Platform reliability

  • Resolve P1/P2 incidents escalated by the 24x7 monitoring team; lead root-cause analysis and corrective actions for recurring container-platform incidents.

  • Define and tune EKS/container monitoring, alert thresholds and dashboards with the monitoring team.

  • Maintain runbooks, cluster configuration records and the EKS entries in the scope register.

CI/CD and DevOps support for application teams

  • Support the application teams' pipelines (deployments, Helm charts/manifests, image builds, ECR, GitOps tooling) and troubleshoot failed deployments to the platform layer.

  • Set and enforce platform standards: namespaces, RBAC, resource quotas, pod security, network policies and image/registry hygiene.

  • Build and maintain the IaC for the clusters alongside the CCoE platform engineer — Terraform/CloudFormation, eksctl and automation of repeatable changes.

Security and change

  • Remediate container-platform vulnerability findings (nodes, images, add-ons) within agreed windows; apply node patching and AMI refreshes on the agreed cycle.

  • Plan, document and execute changes through the customer's change process (ServiceNow/JSM), including work plans and post-implementation verification.

  • Contribute EKS content to monthly service reports and quarterly business reviews.

Required qualifications

  • 5+ years in cloud infrastructure or DevOps roles, with 3+ years operating production Kubernetes; at least 2 of those on Amazon EKS.

  • Hands-on with the EKS ecosystem: managed node groups, Karpenter or Cluster Autoscaler, VPC CNI, IRSA/Pod Identity, EBS/EFS CSI, AWS Load Balancer Controller.

  • Has led at least two production Kubernetes version upgrades end to end, including deprecated-API remediation with application teams.

  • Strong CI/CD experience with at least one of GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or AWS CodePipeline, plus Helm and a GitOps tool (Argo CD or Flux).

  • Infrastructure-as-code in Terraform or CloudFormation; comfortable with eksctl and the AWS CLI.

  • Container observability: Prometheus/Grafana, CloudWatch Container Insights or Datadog; able to define SLIs and alert thresholds.

  • Incident and change discipline: has worked under an ITIL-style change process and an SLA-backed managed service or SRE function.

  • Linux administration and scripting (Bash, Python).

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or higher, or willing to obtain within 90 days.

  • Fluent professional English; able to write runbooks and RCA reports for a customer audience.

  • Authorized to work in the United States; able to pass a customer background check.

Preferred qualifications

  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) and/or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional.

  • Experience at an MSP or in a multi-tenant / multi-account AWS organization (AWS Organizations, Control Tower, SCPs).

  • Service mesh (Istio, App Mesh) and secrets management (External Secrets, AWS Secrets Manager).

  • Container security tooling (Wiz, Trivy, Amazon Inspector, ECR scanning) and pod security standards.

  • Exposure to Azure (AKS) or GCP (GKE) — the engagement is multicloud.

  • Korean language ability is a plus but not required.

  • Experience supporting automotive, manufacturing or large Korean-headquartered enterprise customers.

Working model

  • Hours: Engineering and change work in service hours, 08:00–18:00 Pacific, Monday–Friday. Candidates in any US time zone are welcome if they cover Pacific hours.

  • On-call: Participates in the AWS escalation rotation for P1/P2 incidents and emergency changes outside service hours; 24x7 first response is handled by the offshore monitoring team.

  • Travel: Occasional travel to the customer's site in Southern California for planning sessions, upgrades and QBRs (estimate one trip per quarter).

  • Contract-to-hire: Initial engagement as a contractor with conversion to full-time employment on performance, targeted within 6 months.

  • Tooling you'll use: AWS console/CLI, Terraform, Helm, Argo CD or Flux, ServiceNow and Jira Service Management, MegaFlow (Megazone's operations platform), Datadog/CloudWatch, Slack.

Why You'll Love It Here

  • Our Product is Our People: We live by this. We invest in people who invest in themselves. Your growth is our growth.

  • True Servant Leadership: Our CTO leads with a "force multiplier" philosophy. Management is here to empower you and clear roadblocks, not to micromanage. We won't ask you to do anything we're not willing to do ourselves.

  • Flat Organization, Real Impact: Your voice and designs will directly shape our technical roadmap and our clients' success. You'll work on the latest tech to solve real problems.

  • A "Learn-from-it" Culture: We're moving fast and building new things. We believe mistakes are learning opportunities, not failures.

We seek diverse talent who are ready to make an immediate impact. We believe that innovation thrives when teams are built with a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you are excited by this mission, we encourage you to apply, even if your experience doesn't perfectly match every qualification listed.

Megazone Cloud is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all new hires.
